answer.question: At 20m/s, can the elevator produce an initial pitch acceleration of at least 0.12 rad/s²?
answer.explanation0: The initial pitch acceleration answers my question because if it is met, it means that the pushing effect of the elevator is enough to overcome the nose-down moment. The requirement is met if this value is greater than or equal to 0.12 rad/s².
answer.scope: Initial pitch response at the stated condition

reflection.observation:
I observed that at 20 m/s and 14 m/s speed, it generates enough acceleration to meet the minimum requirement and therefore the elevator has pitch authority at these speeds. However, at 10m/s the acceleration requirement is not met and therefore the elevator cannot provide the required push. 
Yes my engineering question has been answered as at 20m/s, the elevator produces an initial pitch acceleration of at least 0.12 rad/s².
